title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' chases 'Avengers: Endgame' opening record with $355 million domestic debut
summary_full: Sony and Marvel's "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" snared $355 million in estimated domestic box office on its opening weekend, the second-highest debut of all time.
summary_public: Sony and Marvel's "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" snared $355 million in estimated domestic box office on its opening weekend, the second-highest debut of all time.
